The '''Kira Fortress''' was a [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] in the wilderness of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] owned by the [[House of Kira]]. It was located far from [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] and one hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from the [[Shatoon Monastery]].

==History==
[[File:Kira_Fortress.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The entrance to Kira Fortress.]]
A stone fortress established in the jungles of Onderon, the [[House of Kira]] emerged among the strongest of the so-called [[Beast Riders]]; a group of men and women exiled from [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] who came together to form their own community out in the wilds. Taming the wild beasts which flew to the planet from the Demon Moon of [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]], the Beast Riders resided at the Kira Fortress and flew under the banner of Lord [[Modon Kira]] and his family. As they became stronger, the [[Beast Rider army]] flew against the city of Iziz in a conflict later known as the [[Beast Wars]]. Abducting the [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Galia]] from the [[Iziz Royal Palace|Royal Palace]], Kira returned with her to the fortress where Galia were wed Kira's son [[Oron Kira|Oron]], not through force, but out of a love they both shared.<ref name="TOTJ2" />

When King [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]] retook the city of Iziz after a successful raid by the Beast Raiders, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] and [[Tott Doneeta]] were forced back to the fortress along with Kira and his bride, Galia.<ref name="FNU1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 1]]</ref> Fighting back against the [[Naddist]]s in the city, the group eventually defeated Ommin and Oron Kira was crowned King of Onderon and leader of the [[Iziz ruling family|Onderon Royal Family]]. Having brought the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]] to an end,<ref name="FNU2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 2]]</ref> the Kira lineage became forever tied with the history of the planet and the fortress survived the many centuries as the historic family home of the Royal Family.<ref name="EE2">[[Empire's End 2|''Empire's End'' 2]]</ref>

As of [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Onderon was ruled by a descendant of Kira, [[Modon Kira (Galactic Civil War)|Modon Kira]], named after his ancestor. Kira welcomed [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], a leading member of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] as she took refuge at the fortress during her struggle against the resurgent [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. When Palpatine arrived to take the children, he was killed by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], Organa's husband. The Emperor's spirit was consumed by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Empatojayos Brand]], finally bringing an end to the era's most dangerous [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]].<ref name="EE2" />
